_meta.note: One-sentence teacher-facing rationales, keyed by accommodation id, explaining WHY each support attached to the plan. Surfaced through the accommodations resolver so Penny can explain her choices. DRAFTS pending teacher voice review.

rationales.activity_preview_routine: A two-minute preview lowers anticipatory anxiety by making the lesson predictable, which frees working memory for the content instead of for worrying about what comes next.
rationales.alternate_response_oral_scribed: When the goal is demonstrating understanding, the writing channel shouldn't gatekeep it — oral or scribed responses assess the same standard without the motor or transcription barrier.
rationales.assignment_preview_day_before: Seeing tomorrow's task today turns an unknown stressor into a rehearsed routine, which is often the difference between avoidance and a strong start.
rationales.attention_refocus_cue: A private cue redirects attention without public correction, preserving the student's dignity and your relationship while keeping them in the lesson.
rationales.bilingual_glossary_es: Students reading in a second language comprehend grade-level content far better when key terms are anchored in their strongest language first — vocabulary access is content access.
rationales.calculator_allowed_lane: When computation isn't the standard being assessed, the calculator removes a barrier without touching the rigor of the reasoning you're actually measuring.
rationales.calm_down_break_pass: A pre-arranged break route lets the student regulate before escalation instead of after, turning a potential blow-up into a five-minute reset.
rationales.captions_required: Captions support students who process print better than audio, and they help every student catch terminology — accessibility that doubles as vocabulary instruction.
rationales.checklist_multi_step_writing: Writing assignments stack planning, organizing, and transcription at once; a step checklist offloads the executive-function load so effort goes into the writing itself.
rationales.chunked_directions_steps: Multi-step directions delivered all at once exceed many students' working-memory span — three confirmed steps means everyone starts the task with the same map.
rationales.chunked_task_checklist: Big tasks stall students with initiation or working-memory needs; visible chunks with checkboxes create momentum and a built-in progress record.
rationales.closed_captioning_multimedia: Speaker-labeled captions let students who are deaf, hard of hearing, or processing-challenged follow who said what — without them, video content is partially inaccessible.
rationales.color_overlay_reading: For some students with visual stress, an overlay reduces the glare and letter-crowding that make sustained reading exhausting; letting them choose the color keeps the tool theirs.
rationales.direction_repetition_protocol: Hearing directions twice in different words gives students two chances to encode them — and the comprehension check catches the gap before it becomes a failed task.
rationales.dyslexia_friendly_font: Increased letter spacing and dyslexia-aware letterforms reduce decoding effort, so the student's energy goes to comprehension instead of letter discrimination.
rationales.end_of_task_signal: Clear 'when finished' instructions prevent the dead time where off-task behavior starts, and they protect early finishers from anxiety about what's expected next.
rationales.enlarged_workspace_response: Bigger answer spaces remove the fine-motor squeeze that makes students with handwriting needs abbreviate their thinking to fit the box.
rationales.extended_time_1_5x: Processing speed and output speed aren't understanding — 1.5x time lets the student show what they know rather than what they could rush.
rationales.extended_time_2x: On formal assessments, doubled time accommodates documented processing needs so the score reflects mastery of the standard, not reading or output speed.
rationales.flexible_participation_mode: Multiple participation channels mean students who freeze at public speaking still engage with the same thinking — participation is the goal, performance anxiety isn't the filter.
rationales.graphic_organizer_writing: An organizer externalizes the structure of extended writing, so students with organization needs plan on paper instead of holding the whole essay in working memory.
rationales.grouping_roles_strip: Named, rotating roles give every group member a legitimate way in — they prevent both social loafing and the pattern where confident students absorb all the practice.
rationales.guided_notes_inline: Margin frames focus note-taking on the key ideas, supporting students who can't simultaneously listen, decide what matters, and transcribe.
rationales.leveled_summary_box_el: A leveled summary alongside the grade-level text gives multilingual learners a comprehension anchor without removing them from the real text — support, not substitution.
rationales.leveled_summary_box_two_bands: A simplified summary box gives striving readers a way to confirm the main idea, which paradoxically helps them persist in the harder full text.
rationales.manipulatives_math_concepts: Physical models give abstract relationships something to be ABOUT — students with conceptual gaps need to see and move the math before symbols carry meaning.
rationales.math_reference_sheet_dyscalculia: A visible reference sheet offloads fact and formula retrieval, so a student with dyscalculia can spend their cognition on the problem-solving the lesson actually targets.
rationales.microbreak_every_2_items: Brief movement resets attention before fatigue degrades accuracy — for many students two items is the real attention span, and the break buys back the next two.
rationales.movement_break_protocol: Scheduled, discreet movement lets students with attention or sensory needs regulate without leaving the lesson or drawing peer attention.
rationales.opt_out_with_alternative: A dignified pass option with an alternative demonstration keeps anxious students accountable to the learning without forcing the public performance that shuts them down.
rationales.predictability_schedule_post: A consistent, posted structure converts the classroom from a source of uncertainty into a routine — for anxious students, predictability is a precondition for learning.
rationales.preferential_seating_front: Proximity to instruction cuts the distraction field and makes your nonverbal cues usable, often replacing a dozen verbal redirections per period.
rationales.private_response_option: Private response channels capture the thinking of students whose anxiety blocks public answers — you assess the same understanding without the audience.
rationales.progress_checkin_timer: A predictable check-in rhythm catches stalls early and tells the student someone will notice their effort — accountability that feels like support, not surveillance.
rationales.quiet_workspace_option: Noise is cognitive load for students with auditory sensitivity or attention needs; a quiet option lets them spend that capacity on the task.
rationales.read_aloud_option: When decoding isn't the standard, audio access separates reading ability from content learning so the text's ideas reach every student.
rationales.reduced_distractions_mode: A low-stimulation setting removes the environmental competition for attention that some students cannot filter out on their own.
rationales.reduced_items_50: Fewer items at the same rigor measures mastery without the endurance test — the starred subset covers the standard while respecting processing pace.
rationales.reduced_text_density: White space is comprehension support: fewer items per page reduces visual overwhelm and makes tracking easier for students with attention or visual processing needs.
rationales.reduced_writing_quantity: Halving the output while keeping the rigor assesses the same standard — for students with motor or stamina barriers, volume was never the construct.
rationales.safe_space_identification: Knowing exactly where to go when overwhelmed converts a potential crisis into a routine — the safety plan works because it was made before it was needed.
rationales.scribe_option_extended_writing: Dictation to a scribe separates composition from transcription, letting a student with written-output needs show the full depth of their thinking.
rationales.sentence_frames_CER: CER frames make the invisible structure of scientific argument visible, so students learn the reasoning move instead of guessing at the format.
rationales.sentence_frames_language_scaffold: Frames give multilingual learners the syntactic skeleton of academic English, so their cognitive effort goes into the idea instead of the grammar.
rationales.separate_setting_assessment: A quiet, separate setting removes the distraction and social pressure that inflate anxiety during assessments, producing a score closer to true mastery.
rationales.speech_to_text_response: Speech-to-text turns spoken fluency into written output, bypassing the transcription barrier for students whose ideas outrun their handwriting or typing.
rationales.strategic_seating_focus: Low-traffic seating shrinks the distraction field at its source — placement is the cheapest, most reliable attention intervention available.
rationales.success_acknowledgment_private: Private, process-focused praise reinforces effort without the public spotlight that some students experience as threat rather than reward.
rationales.task_initiation_prompt: Many students know HOW to do the task but stall at starting; a brief individual prompt at minute zero prevents ten minutes of frozen time.
rationales.text_to_speech_dyslexia: Synchronized text-to-speech pairs the sound with the print, supporting decoding while preserving access to grade-level ideas at the student's listening level.
rationales.transition_warning_2min: Transitions are where dysregulation happens; a two-minute dual-channel warning gives the student time to close one mental file before opening the next.
rationales.typing_instead_of_handwriting: When handwriting is the barrier and not the standard, keyboard access converts a motor task back into a thinking task.
rationales.visual_note_companion: Icon-and-symbol companion notes give students a second channel into verbal instruction, anchoring spoken ideas to images they can revisit.
rationales.visual_schedule_block: A visible lesson map lets students track where they are and what's next, reducing the transition anxiety that comes from not knowing.
rationales.visual_timer_display: A visual countdown makes abstract time concrete, helping students with time-blindness pace their work without repeated verbal reminders.
rationales.visual_transition_cues: Visual signals reach students who miss or can't process auditory cues, making transitions accessible instead of startling.
rationales.wait_time_extension: Ten seconds of wait time lets students with slower processing formulate real answers — cold-calling before they're ready measures speed, not understanding.
rationales.word_prediction_software: Word prediction cuts the keystrokes between idea and sentence, sustaining writing stamina for students with spelling or motor barriers.
rationales.working_memory_reference_card: A persistent reference card holds the formulas and steps the task requires, so limited working memory is spent on reasoning rather than recall.
rationales.written_backup_verbal_directions: Posting directions in writing backs up the auditory channel — students who miss a spoken step can recover without asking or guessing.
rationales.asd_social_narrative_support: A short first-person narrative previews the social script of a challenging activity, replacing unpredictability — the core stressor — with a rehearsed story.
rationales.asd_first_then_board: The first-then board makes the path to a preferred activity concrete and visual, supporting task initiation through predictable sequence rather than verbal negotiation.
rationales.asd_sensory_break_card: A break card gives the student a dignified, pre-taught way to manage sensory overload before it becomes a shutdown — regulation with autonomy.
rationales.asd_reduced_sensory_environment: Reducing ambient sensory load (traffic, vents, flicker) removes the background stressors that compete with instruction for an autistic student's attention.
rationales.asd_explicit_social_cues: Stating social expectations explicitly turns the hidden curriculum of group work into learnable rules instead of a guessing game.
rationales.asd_peer_mediated_roles: Explicit roles with visual cards structure peer interaction so collaboration depends on the defined job, not on intuiting unwritten social rules.
rationales.asd_video_modeling_preview: Watching the complete procedure before attempting it gives a concrete, replayable model — far more reliable than holding multi-step verbal directions in mind.
rationales.asd_task_analysis_checklist: Numbered steps with checkboxes convert an overwhelming task into a visible sequence, supporting initiation and self-monitoring at once.
rationales.asd_transition_warning_sequence: Layered warnings (5-2-0.5 minutes) let the student disengage on a predictable gradient instead of an abrupt demand, which is where most transition distress starts.
rationales.asd_interest_based_examples: Routing practice through a student's deep interests recruits genuine motivation and prior knowledge — engagement that no generic context can match.
rationales.asd_literal_language_check: Pausing to decode idioms protects literal-language processors from quietly losing the thread every time figurative speech enters the lesson.
rationales.ebd_check_in_check_out: The daily rating cycle gives the student frequent, structured feedback and an adult relationship anchored to growth — the two strongest levers for behavior change.
rationales.ebd_self_monitoring_checklist: Self-rating against positively-worded behaviors shifts the locus of control to the student, building the self-regulation the support is meant to grow.
rationales.ebd_choice_board: Equivalent choices satisfy the need for autonomy that often drives refusal — the student controls the how, you keep the what.
rationales.ebd_cool_down_protocol: A practiced cool-down route, taught when calm, gives the student a way out of escalation that preserves dignity and avoids the consequence spiral.
rationales.ebd_precorrection_prompt: A quiet reminder of the expectation BEFORE the challenging moment prevents the behavior you'd otherwise have to correct after.
rationales.ebd_break_pass_system: A limited supply of no-questions-asked passes lets the student self-regulate within agreed boundaries — structure and trust at the same time.
rationales.ebd_positive_reinforcement: Specific, immediate praise tells the student exactly which behavior paid off, building the target behavior faster than any consequence reduces the unwanted one.
rationales.ebd_antecedent_management: Adjusting triggers before the situation occurs treats the cause instead of the symptom — the most effective behavior intervention happens before the behavior.
rationales.ebd_private_signal_system: A co-created private signal lets you redirect without an audience, removing the peer-attention payoff that public corrections often feed.
rationales.ebd_restorative_reentry: A brief restorative conversation after regulation rebuilds the relationship and the plan, so the incident ends in learning rather than just consequence.
rationales.pm_fatigue_management: Built-in break points respect the real energy cost of motor effort, protecting accuracy and participation across the whole period instead of just its first half.
rationales.pm_alternative_response_methods: When motor demands would mask knowledge, alternative response channels let the assessment measure the construct instead of the disability.
rationales.pm_assistive_tech_access: Reliable, consequence-proof access to assistive tech is the difference between having an accommodation on paper and having one in practice.
rationales.pm_positioning_support: Recommended positioning supports protect comfort and stamina, which are preconditions for attention — discomfort is a full-time distraction.
rationales.pm_extended_time_motor: Automatic extended time for motor-heavy tasks removes the burden of asking, so the student's pace is planned for rather than negotiated.
rationales.pm_reduced_motor_load: Providing notes and fill-in formats cuts copying — a motor task with near-zero learning value — and reinvests that time in thinking.
rationales.pm_peer_support_dignity: Trained peer partnership framed as collaboration gives physical support without casting the student as a recipient of help — reciprocity protects dignity.
rationales.pm_environmental_accessibility: Clear pathways and in-reach materials make independence physically possible — environmental barriers are the easiest disability barriers to remove.
rationales.vi_high_contrast_materials: High-contrast materials keep text within the student's usable vision, preventing the silent fatigue of decoding low-contrast print.
rationales.vi_audio_description: Narrating visual content as you present it gives a student with low vision the same information stream their classmates get from the screen.
rationales.vi_large_print_materials: Properly enlarged, single-sided materials match the student's documented acuity so reading is about comprehension, not magnification effort.
rationales.vi_screen_reader_compatible: Tagged PDFs, alt-text, and heading structure are what make digital materials exist at all for a screen-reader user — an untagged scan is a blank page.
rationales.vi_verbal_spatial_cueing: Clock-position and distance cues replace visual pointing with information the student can actually use, keeping them oriented and independent.
rationales.vi_tactile_braille_materials: Braille and tactile graphics, ordered with lead time, give the student first-class access to the same content — not a verbal summary of someone else's materials.
rationales.annotated_exemplar: An annotated exemplar shows what quality looks like AND the thinking behind it, replacing vague expectations with a visible target.
rationales.self_monitoring_checklist: A self-monitoring checklist builds the habit of checking one's own work — the executive-function skill the accommodation is quietly teaching.
rationales.simplified_directions: Plainer language removes the linguistic barrier between the student and the task while keeping the expectation itself untouched.
rationales.visual_vocabulary_card: Image-anchored vocabulary cards give the word three hooks — picture, definition, and text connection — so retrieval survives the working-memory squeeze of a live lesson.
